Manual workflows represent substantial operational and reputational risks as errors slow down operations and in the worst cases lead to settlement failures. Meanwhile, the proliferation of messages required to manage a multitude of bilateral trading relationships hamstrings operations and can be costly. The race is on to find more reliable and effective approaches to interests matching, workflow automation, and collaboration to unlock efficiencies and productivity. Dealing. Digitised By automating dealing workflows and enhancing communication protocols, our platform reduces the operational risks and inefficiencies associated with dealing while enhancing the effectiveness of users. With Wematch, liquidity channels are optimis ed and brought to scale in a digital marketplace that enables dealers to rapidly discover new opportunities, borrowers to access new financing structures, and market makers to establish quotes. Our platform also enables financial institutions to integrate their trading book more easily and increase the data available for better post-deal management and optimisation. Benefits at-a-glance Worldwide, Wematch is helping 85+ financial institutions digitally transform their trading operations. jobs.description: Regulatory | Wematch.Live Skip to content Platform Regulatory About Careers Resources Platform Regulatory About Careers Resources Get in Touch Home Platform About Careers Resources Book a Demo Home Platform About Careers Resources Book a Demo Book a Demo Regulatory Wematch.live FS Ltd (registered number 14144354) is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (“FCA”) under FRN: 1019144 to operate a Multilateral Trading Facility (MTF). The Wematch.live MTF Operator : Wematch.live FS Ltd Trading : Securities Financing Transactions, including: Total Return Swaps Securities Borrowing and Lending Repos Collateral Financing Transactions Rulebook MTF Rulebook v1.03 Membership Terms & Conditions MTF Membership Terms & Conditions v1.04 Fee Schedule Fee Schedule Other Documents Wematch Services Privacy Policy MTF Risk Disclosure Statement MTF Conflicts of Interest Policy Wematch MTF Onboarding - FAQs 1) Which products will be executed through the Wematch MTF? Wematch MTF will allow members to match and execute Total Return Swaps (TRS), Securities Lending & Borrowing (SBL), and Repurchase Agreements (Repos). 2) What is the Operator MIC code of the Wematch MTF? The Operator MIC code of the Wematch MTF is WMFS. 3) What are the Segment codes of the Wematch MTF? The Segment codes of the Wematch MTF are: WMSW for Total Return Swaps (TRS) WMSL for Securities Lending & Borrowing (SBL) and Repurchase Agreements (Repos) 4) Which legal entity will operate the Wematch MTF? The Wematch MTF will be operated by Wematch.live FS Ltd (LEI: 984500DJ5C3EMDB7DD03), a regulated entity approved by the FCA (with Firm Reference Number 1019144) to operate a Multilateral Trading Facility (MTF). 5) Where can I find the Wematch MTF members’ Terms & Conditions? The Wematch MTF members Terms & Conditions can be found in the Regulatory section of the wematch.live website, shown above: https://wematch.live/regulatory 6) Where can I find the Wematch MTF Rulebook? The Wematch MTF Rulebook can be found in the Regulatory section of the wematch.live website, shown above: https://wematch.live/regulatory/ 7) Will Wematch do Transaction Reporting (RTS 22) on the trades executed through the MTF? Wematch MTF will submit a Transaction Report (RTS 22) to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) when a transaction in a reportable financial instrument (Total Return Swap and not Repo and SBL) is executed through its systems by a Member not subject to UK MiFIR. 8) When will the Wematch MTF be active? The Wematch MTF will be active on April 1st, 2026. 9) What happens to my current trades that are still open in Wematch as of April 1st, 2026? All outstanding breakable KBLM trades will be unwound on KBLM and simultaneously reopened on the Wematch.live MTF on value date 1 April 2026 (settlement date 3 April 2026, with no settlement as all netted). This approach is designed to ensure a smooth and controlled operational transition with minimal disruption to your trading activity. For the sake of clarification, non-breakable TRS trades still open on KBLM on April 1st will naturally mature on KBLM with no impact on the Wematch MTF. 10) Do I need to expect any change in the workflow? No, we do not expect any change in the workflow, and Wematch users can continue to use the platform in the exact same way. 11) Will you change my login link? Yes, updated login links will be sent on April 1st, 2026 in the morning. Discover Wematch Book a 15-min demo to learn how our platform can help you. jobs.description: Lihi Bitton Benifla, Head of Human Resources, Tel Aviv Office | Wematch.Live Skip to content Platform Regulatory About Careers Resources Platform Regulatory About Careers Resources Get in Touch Home Platform About Careers Resources Book a Demo Home Platform About Careers Resources Book a Demo Book a Demo Lihi Bitton Benifla, Head of Human Resources, Tel Aviv Office Back to Careers Welcome back to the Wematch Talent Project, where we spotlight the remarkable professionals propelling Wematch.live to new heights! Today, we’re thrilled to spotlight Lihi Bitton Benifla, our phenomenal Head of HR based in Tel Aviv. Lihi shares her inspirational career journey, her contributions to Wematch, and what motivates her each day. Wematch.live: Hi Lihi! To start, can you tell us about your background and what led you to your role at Wematch? Lihi: Of course! I’m a lawyer by training, specialising in labour law. But my true passion has always been connecting with people. I was looking for my next adventure when fate brought me together with my now-manager at an industry event. We had a fantastic conversation, and the rest is history! I was drawn to Wematch’s vision and the chance to grow with a startup. Wematch.live: Connecting with people seems central to what motivates you. What specifically piqued your interest in joining Wematch? Lihi: The inspiring vision coupled with the opportunity for personal and professional development. The company was much smaller when I joined, allowing me to take on more responsibilities and see my ideas come to life. I felt I could keep learning and contributing in a meaningful way. Wematch.live: It sounds like the chance to grow and take on more was very appealing. Walk us through a typical day in your role. What’s most enjoyable about it? Lihi: Without a doubt, the People of Wematch make each day enjoyable! Having inspiring colleagues fuels my own growth. From recruitment to talent development and global HR coordination, no two days are the same. It’s dynamic and enriching. Wematch.live: It’s wonderful to hear how much you enjoy engaging with your colleagues. Reflecting on your time here so far, what accomplishments make you most proud? Lihi: I’m proud that as we’ve grown, we’ve maintained our special culture. Fostering connections with a globally dispersed team is both challenging and rewarding. We host weekly virtual meetings to keep us aligned across borders, and sometimes to have some fun! Wematch.live: Maintaining that special culture across borders is impressive. How do you feel Wematch has supported your professional development? Lihi: Immensely. The startup rhythm exposes me to diverse responsibilities. I handle recruitment, employee engagement, benefits, and more. It’s been incredibly developmental. Wematch.live: What do you love most about the culture at Wematch? Lihi: The transparency stands out. People feel comfortable reaching out to leadership about anything. It creates an open, supportive environment that I really appreciate. Wematch.live: Transparency and openness are so valuable. What motivates you daily? Any special sources of inspiration? Lihi: My family, especially my husband. Despite challenges, he perseveres and impresses me daily. His resilience motivates me tremendously. Wematch.live: When you’re not working, how do you like to spend your time? Lihi: Staying active is important, so I try to hit the gym several times a week. Pilates is my favourite! I also enjoy catching up with friends and travelling when I can. Some guilty pleasures are binge-watching reality TV and keeping up with the Kardashians! In the spirit of appreciation for our global team members, we want to acknowledge Lihi’s resilience and dedication, particularly during these challenging times. Her commitment to growth and passion for her work are truly inspiring. Lihi exemplifies Wematch’s culture: her growth mindset and dedication to people inspire us daily. Stay tuned for more uplifting stories of Wematch excellence! If you’re interested in joining our innovative team, you can review our open roles at wematch.live/careers and check out our latest opportunities! jobs.description: Astrid Levy, Office Manager, Paris Office | Wematch.Live Skip to content Platform Regulatory About Careers Resources Platform Regulatory About Careers Resources Get in Touch Home Platform About Careers Resources Book a Demo Home Platform About Careers Resources Book a Demo Book a Demo Astrid Levy, Office Manager, Paris Office Back to Careers We’re pleased to speak with Astrid Levy, Wematch’s Paris Office Manager, who joined us in June 2023, to learn more about her background and experiences. Wematch : Bonjour Astrid! Tell us a bit more about your career journey before joining Wematch. Astrid : Well, earlier in my career I worked in event planning and coordination roles where I enjoyed the creativity and organising. After a few years in event planning, I decided to take a break to focus on raising my three children. I spent a wonderful 6 years at home with my kids and have so many special memories from that time. When I was ready to return to work, I knew I wanted a role that provided variety and allowed me to utilise my coordination strengths. I’ve spent several years as an office manager in a human resources company. After having a fourth baby, I discovered the Paris Office Manager opportunity at Wematch – it seemed like the perfect multifaceted role to leverage my skills. Wematch : Motherhood is the most important job of all! What initially caught your interest when you were exploring the Wematch opportunity? Astrid : The warmth and kindness of the people stood out during my interviews. I could tell right away this was a thoughtful, caring team. And I was excited by the modern, youthful energy and innovative fintech approach. The chance to expand my skills in finance was appealing too. It just felt like an engaging, welcoming environment. Wematch : Now that you’ve been in the role for a while, what parts of your day-to-day work do you find most rewarding? Astrid : No two days are the same, and I get to help people across the company, which is so fulfilling. Whether it’s coordinating meetings, ordering supplies, or greeting guests – every task allows me to contribute. And the sincerity and appreciation of my colleagues make everything rewarding. Wematch : Looking back so far, what accomplishments are you most proud of since joining Wematch? Astrid : While still early days, I’m proud that I’ve been able to quickly get up to speed and become a useful, reliable resource for my team. Being able to quickly adapt to a new world and provide support feels like an accomplishment. Wematch : We couldn’t agree more! On the flip side, what areas are you hoping to grow and develop more skills in going forward? Astrid : Finance is an area I’m hoping to build more acumen over time. By learning the ins and outs of the industry, I’ll be able to better understand my role and provide even more value. Expanding my finance knowledge is definitely a goal. Wematch : As you think ahead over the next few years, what are your ideal career goals? Astrid : My main career goal is simply to continue growing in my role at Wematch in a fulfilling way. I aim to take on new challenges when they arise but also pace myself. As long as I feel engaged and happy in my work, that’s success for me. Astrid exemplifies what it means to be a thoughtful, dedicated team player. Her versatile contributions and warm presence make Wematch a better place to work every day. We’re thrilled to have her on our team! If you’re interested in joining our innovative team, review our open roles at wematch.live/careers and check out our latest opportunities! With a presence in London, Paris, New York, Hong Kong, and Tel Aviv, we are bringing transparency, auditability, and control to traditionally voice-traded markets. Since 2017, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital transformation in global capital markets with our award-winning platform. Our technology digitizes trading workflows for banks, clients, and internal teams, offering features such as smart matching, negotiation, lifecycle management, and both internal and external flows. Our platform serves over 1,000 dealers at 85+ financial institutions globally, covering asset classes including Securities Finance, Interest Rate Swaps, and Equity Derivatives. Your Role As a Securities Finance Coverage specialist, you’ll play a critical role in fostering client relationships and driving the growth of our platform. Your day-to-day responsibilities include: Client Engagement : Regular, direct interaction with securities finance traders, sales teams, and middle-office professionals at banks to ensure platform adoption and usage. Platform Monitoring & Support : Oversee the daily monitoring of the platform, focusing on facilitating trading activities, especially in Securities Borrowing and Lending (SBL). Client Feedback : Actively gather client feedback and share key insights with the Coverage and Product teams through daily calls. Relationship Building : Develop strong relationships with traders and clients on the Wematch platform, ensuring their specific needs are met. Client Reviews & Usage Growth : Conduct regular reviews with clients to ensure continued platform engagement and usage expansion. Business Understanding : Gain a deep understanding of clients’ unique business requirements to better support their goals. Your Profile We’re looking for someone with a solid foundation in Securities Finance and a passion for technology-driven solutions. If you meet the following qualifications, we want to hear from you: A post-graduate degree in a relevant field or 3–10 years of experience in Securities Finance Trading and/or Sales. Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, in English. A keen eye for detail and strong organizational abilities. A proactive, self-motivated approach with a strong work ethic. Series 7 & 63 Licenses (Required). Previous experience with financial institutions or capital markets is a plus. Salary & Benefits Salary Range : $100,000 – $175,000/year (Full-time). Stock options and performance incentives . Join a fast-paced, dynamic team at the cutting edge of financial technology. Why Wematch? We believe in a team-oriented, inclusive, and open culture. At Wematch, every voice matters, and your contributions will have a direct impact on the success of our mission. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and grow in a challenging environment, working alongside talented individuals who are passionate about transforming the future of global capital markets. We welcome diverse perspectives and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. If you’re ready to make a difference, join us in shaping the future of finance!
